info.title: Injury deaths by county and state (CDC): drug overdose, suicide, homicide and firearm injury: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Injury deaths by county and state (CDC): drug overdose, suicide, homicide and firearm injury: Deaths from drug overdose, suicide, homicide and firearm injury in CDC's Mapping Injury, Overdose, and Violence files, for the nation, each state and DC and each county, by calendar year and for the trailing twelve months: deaths and the rate per 100,000 residents. National and state records add unintentional-injury deaths from the NCHS leading-causes file, 1999 to 2017. Counts of 1 to 9 stay in the range CDC prints.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
